title: ITC to acquire organic FMCG staples brand 24 Mantra Organic for ₹472.5 crore
summary: ITC has agreed to acquire organic FMCG staples brand 24 Mantra Organic for ₹472.5 crore, a deal reported by CNBC TV18 on April 17, 2025. The acquisition expands ITC's presence in the organic and packaged foods segment, reflecting growing consumer demand for organic products and continued consolidation in the Indian FMCG market.
content:
ITC has agreed to acquire 24 Mantra Organic, an organic FMCG staples brand, for a consideration of ₹472.5 crore, according to a report by CNBC TV18 dated April 17, 2025.

The announcement marks a strategic move by ITC to broaden its footprint in the organic and health-focused foods category. ITC, a diversified Indian conglomerate with an established presence in cigarettes, hotels, paperboards, packaging, agribusiness and fast-moving consumer goods, has been steadily expanding its consumer foods portfolio in recent years.

24 Mantra Organic is positioned in the organic staples and packaged foods market, catering to consumers seeking organic and natural food options. The brand's product range and distribution network in the organic segment are likely to be key assets for ITC as it seeks to strengthen its offerings to health-conscious shoppers.

Industry analysts expect the acquisition to provide ITC with greater access to the fast-growing organic foods market in India, where demand has been rising alongside increased awareness of health and sustainability. The deal may also offer supply-chain synergies and opportunities to scale the brand using ITC's distribution and marketing capabilities.

Financial and operational details beyond the headline consideration were limited in the initial report. The companies will likely complete customary regulatory and closing formalities before integrating the business into ITC's consumer products operations.

The transaction underscores continuing consolidation in the Indian FMCG sector as larger players acquire niche and premium brands to diversify portfolios and capture changing consumer preferences. CNBC TV18 reported the development on April 17, 2025.

## Deal overview

ITC has agreed to acquire 24 Mantra Organic, an organic FMCG staples brand, for a consideration of ₹472.5 crore, according to a report by CNBC TV18 dated April 17, 2025.

## Strategic rationale

The announcement marks a strategic move by ITC to broaden its footprint in the organic and health-focused foods category. ITC has been steadily expanding its consumer foods portfolio in recent years as it looks to strengthen offerings to health-conscious shoppers.

## About ITC

ITC is a diversified Indian conglomerate with an established presence in:
- cigarettes
- hotels
- paperboards and packaging
- agribusiness
- fast-moving consumer goods

## About 24 Mantra Organic

24 Mantra Organic is positioned in the organic staples and packaged foods market, catering to consumers seeking organic and natural food options. The brand’s product range and distribution network in the organic segment are likely to be key assets for ITC.

## Industry impact and analyst view

Industry analysts expect the acquisition to provide ITC with greater access to the fast-growing organic foods market in India, where demand has been rising alongside increased awareness of health and sustainability. The deal may also offer:
- supply-chain synergies
- opportunities to scale the brand using ITC’s distribution and marketing capabilities

## Financial and regulatory details

Financial and operational details beyond the headline consideration were limited in the initial report. The companies will likely complete customary regulatory and closing formalities before integrating the business into ITC’s consumer products operations.

## Sector context

The transaction underscores continuing consolidation in the Indian FMCG sector as larger players acquire niche and premium brands to diversify portfolios and capture changing consumer preferences.

> CNBC TV18 reported the development on April 17, 2025.
